# Unit tests for the fixed-point arithmetic library (target: fpa_tests).
#
# Not part of the normal build. Enable with -DBUILD_FPA_TESTS=ON (needs network access once, to fetch
# GoogleTest). Run with `ctest --output-on-failure` from the build directory, or run fpa_tests directly.
#
# The expected values for most tests come from vectors/fpa_f<F>.txt, generated by generate_vectors.py.

include(FetchContent)
FetchContent_Declare(
    googletest
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/google/googletest.git
    GIT_TAG        v1.14.0
)
set(INSTALL_GTEST OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(gtest_force_shared_crt ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(googletest)

option(FPA_SANITIZE "Build fpa and the tests with AddressSanitizer + UBSan (GCC/Clang on Linux/macOS; not available in MinGW)" OFF)
if(FPA_SANITIZE)
    # Needed to catch out-of-bounds writes (see the KnownBugs tests). Applies to every target that links fpa.
    target_compile_options(fpa PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer)
    target_link_options(fpa PUBLIC -fsanitize=address,undefined)
endif()

add_executable(fpa_tests
    vector_loader.cpp
    vector_loader.h
    test_support.h
    test_vectors.cpp
    test_edge_cases.cpp
    test_invariants.cpp
    test_cross_format.cpp
    test_random_range.cpp
    test_known_bugs.cpp
    test_decimal.cpp
)
target_link_libraries(fpa_tests PRIVATE fpa GTest::gtest_main)
target_compile_definitions(fpa_tests PRIVATE FPA_VECTOR_DIR=\"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/vectors\")
if(NOT MSVC)
    target_compile_options(fpa_tests PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
endif()

include(GoogleTest)
gtest_discover_tests(fpa_tests DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT 120)
